violation_type.title: Caregiver Handwashing After Using Cleaners or Toxic Chemicals (26 TAC §747.3211(12))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Using Cleaners or Toxic Chemicals
violation_type.typical_finding: One of the two caregivers was seen sanitizing the changing table without washing hands after using chemicals.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.

finding_variants.text: One of the two caregivers was seen sanitizing the changing table without washing hands after using chemicals.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
The caregiver did not wash hands after using cleaning chemicals to sanitize changing table.    This was corrected at inspection when caregiver washed hands.
